parsed.answer: This crash has been reported before. It is a WPF exception, 'Cyclic reference found while evaluating the Style property', thrown from ThemeManager.OnSystemThemeChanged when Windows broadcasts a system theme change. This can happen after an update, at boot, on wake from sleep, or on a light/dark or accent change. PowerToys#47501 has the same stack, including the ListView with 15 items, on 0.99.1.0. Maintainers there suspect PowerToys Run, the WPF module with a ListView result list, as the source. The older tickets (#37291, #38514) show the same cyclic-reference crash with a ScrollViewer and were closed as duplicates of #36451. That ticket's content was not shown, so I can't say what it recommends. None of these tickets gives a confirmed fix or workaround, and none involves Parallels, so the VM is not established as a cause. What you can do: dismiss the error dialog and restart PowerToys, since the crash happens during a theme-change event. Avoid triggering a theme or accent change while PowerToys is starting. Then add your version (0.100.2.0), the Parallels VM detail and your bug report ZIP to #47501, and say whether the crash coincided with a theme or accent change. If it keeps happening at every boot, temporarily turning off PowerToys Run may help narrow it down, though the past tickets do not confirm this.
